name: Vine boom
sounds_like: One deep, reverbed bass 'BOOM' (sub thump + tail), about 1.5 s.
meaning: Realisation, shock, 'did he really just say that'. The universal punchline marker.
timing: Transient lands ON the reaction/punchline frame (frame 0 of the face or text). Freeze or hold 8-12 frames (0.27-0.4 s) at 30 fps, then cut. Never let it run under speech.
visual: Zoom punch to 115-120% in 2-3 frames (ease-out), optional 1-frame flash, freeze on the face, slight shake (2-4 px) for 4 frames.
in_app: Instagram: Add audio > search 'vine boom'; CapCut: Audio > Sound effects > 'vine boom' / 'boom'
risk: Overused: one per video, max. Original sample is not CC0; the library boom is a similar-feel substitute, not the meme itself.

name: Bruh
sounds_like: Flat male voice saying 'bruh' (~0.6 s).
meaning: Disappointment at something dumb (yours or someone else's).
timing: Land 3-6 frames AFTER the fail frame so the fail reads first; hold a freeze 12-15 frames.
visual: Freeze + slow 105% push-in; desaturate slightly.
in_app: CapCut sound effects: 'bruh'; Instagram audio search: 'bruh sound effect'
risk: Voice clip: no CC0 recreation in library (record your own 'bruh' - it is a word, not a copyrighted performance). Dated/cringe in 2026 if used straight; works best ironic.

name: Metal pipe falling
sounds_like: A loud, long, clangy steel pipe hitting concrete with ringing tail (~2 s).
meaning: Absurd sudden fail; something falling that should not; chaos.
timing: Transient exactly on the contact frame; let the ring play over 20-30 frames of freeze or slow-mo.
visual: Hard camera shake 6-8 frames (8-12 px, decaying), no zoom.
in_app: CapCut: 'metal pipe'; Instagram: 'metal pipe falling sound effect'
risk: Very loud: drop it 6 dB under your boom level. Gym plate clank in library is a real-recording alternative that fits gym content without the meme baggage.

name: "Emotional damage!" (Steven He)
sounds_like: Shouted 'EMOTIONAL DAMAGE!' in an exaggerated accent (~1 s).
meaning: A roast landed; someone got verbally destroyed.
timing: Starts on the frame AFTER the insult finishes (no overlap with speech); freeze 20 frames.
visual: Red tint flash 2 frames + zoom to 130% on the victim + shake.
in_app: Instagram audio search: 'emotional damage'; CapCut: 'emotional damage'
risk: Creator-owned voice clip: platform library only. Peak meme was 2021-22; reads dated, use sparingly or ironically.

name: Windows XP error / critical stop
sounds_like: Two-note 'ding-dunk' system error chime (~0.6 s).
meaning: Something just broke: a bad take, a failed build, a wrong opinion.
timing: On the frame a fake error dialog pops in; dialog scales 0->100% over 4 frames with a spring overshoot (105%).
visual: Fake error dialog overlay (make your own, no Microsoft logo), 2-frame shake.
risk: Microsoft-owned sound: in-app library only, never commit. Library ding is a generic substitute. Don't use the Windows logo/branding in the dialog.

name: Windows XP shutdown
sounds_like: Descending 4-note chime (~2 s).
meaning: Giving up, logging off, 'I'm done'.
timing: Start the chime on the last frame of the scene and cut to black on its final note (~60 frames).
visual: Screen-collapse (scale Y to 1 px then out) or simple fade to black.
risk: Microsoft-owned; in-app only.

name: Sad violin / world's smallest violin
sounds_like: Slow, over-emotional solo violin phrase (3-6 s).
meaning: Mock sympathy; first-world problem.
timing: Start on the 'sad' frame, duck everything else -12 dB, cut the violin hard at the next scene cut.
visual: Slow push-in 100->108% over the whole clip, desaturate, optional rain overlay.
risk: Many versions; use the in-app one. Overuse = cringe; best for genuinely petty moments (missed PR by 2.5 kg, flight delayed 20 min).

name: Record scratch + freeze ('Yep, that's me')
sounds_like: Vinyl scratch stopping the music, then silence and a voiceover: 'Yep, that's me. You're probably wondering how I ended up in this situation.'
meaning: Cold-open: start at the chaotic climax, then flash back.
timing: Scratch ends on the freeze frame; music must stop on the same frame. Hold freeze 45-60 frames for the VO line, then hard cut to 'earlier' card.
visual: Freeze-frame, slight desaturation, label/arrow pointing at you.
in_app: Instagram/CapCut: 'record scratch'; record the VO yourself (the line is a format, not a clip).
risk: Safe if you record the VO line yourself; the library scratch is CC0.

name: Anime 'wow' / 'sugoi'
sounds_like: High-pitched anime-girl 'wooow' (~1 s).
meaning: Exaggerated amazement at something mundane.
timing: Begin 2 frames before the reveal so the vowel peaks on the reveal frame.
visual: Sparkle overlay, 110% zoom, pastel colour pop.
in_app: CapCut: 'anime wow'; Instagram: 'anime wow sound effect'
risk: Anime voice clips are copyrighted performances; in-app only. Can read as cringe in serious tech reviews.

name: Phonk / Gigachad edit
sounds_like: Drift/Brazilian phonk: cowbell melody, distorted 808, Memphis vocal chops; or the slowed 'Gigachad theme' (Can You Feel My Heart).
meaning: Aura, dominance, 'he's him'. Gym transformation and gaming highlight edits.
timing: Cut every 1/2 beat in the build, then on the drop: hard cut to the hero shot exactly on the first kick; flash 1 frame; slow-mo after.
visual: Black-and-white high-contrast grade, shake on kicks, velocity speed ramps, glow/bloom.
in_app: Instagram Add audio: search 'phonk', 'aura phonk', 'gigachad'; CapCut Music: 'phonk'
risk: Music is copyrighted: only via in-app library. Business accounts get a restricted library (may not have it). Format is saturated; pair with real progress footage to avoid cringe.

name: Aura farming / aura points
sounds_like: Slow guitar chords (viral 2024 cover of 'Imagine'/'Yesterday' meme audio) or the phonk track 'AURA' by Ogryzek.
meaning: +1000 aura: calm flex, composure under pressure. '-500 aura' for a fail.
timing: Text '+1000 aura' pops on the downbeat (4-frame scale-in with overshoot); hold until next bar.
visual: Slow-mo walk, low angle, counter text '+aura' with pop SFX.
in_app: Instagram audio: 'aura'; CapCut: 'aura edit phonk' templates
risk: Peaked 2024-25; still used in 2026 but stale. Music only via app.

name: 'Stay hard' (David Goggins)
sounds_like: Gravelly intense voice: 'Stay hard!' / 'Who's gonna carry the boats?'
meaning: Discipline, no excuses; the grind.
timing: Put the line at the START of the hardest rep or set (the grimace frame), not after. Music dips -10 dB for the line.
visual: Black-and-white, grain, slow push-in, bold captions word-by-word.
risk: Real person's voice: in-app only, never rip podcast audio. Overused in gym edits; a heartbeat bed + your own VO is a fresh alternative.

name: 'Yeah buddy! Light weight baby!' (Ronnie Coleman)
sounds_like: Ronnie Coleman shouting 'YEAH BUDDY! LIGHT WEIGHT BABY!' / 'Ain't nothin' but a peanut'.
meaning: Ironic hype on a heavy (or very light) lift.
timing: 'Yeah buddy' lands on the lockout frame of the rep; hold 15-20 frames.
visual: Zoom punch on lockout, shake, text 'LIGHTWEIGHT'.
in_app: Instagram audio: 'light weight baby'; CapCut: 'yeah buddy'
risk: Real person's voice; in-app only. Works best ironic (on a 2.5 kg lateral raise).

name: Super Saiyan power-up scream
sounds_like: Building energy hum + scream + aura crackle (~3-5 s).
meaning: Gearing up for a max attempt; pre-workout kicking in.
timing: Riser starts ~2 s before the unrack; the scream peaks on the unrack frame; cut to the lift.
visual: Golden glow overlay, shake building over 30 frames, lightning flashes.
risk: Dragon Ball audio is Toei-owned: in-app only. The library riser + your own yell is a clean recreation.

name: Training montage (Rocky / Eye of the Tiger)
sounds_like: Brass fanfare 'Gonna Fly Now' or 'Eye of the Tiger' riff.
meaning: Classic progress montage; earnest or ironic.
timing: Cut on every bar (4 beats); the final reveal (before/after) lands on the last brass hit.
visual: Split-screen before/after, date stamps, 4:3 film look for irony.
in_app: Instagram music library: 'Gonna Fly Now', 'Eye of the Tiger'
risk: Copyrighted songs; only via in-app music (availability varies by region/account type).

name: Zyzz / aesthetics hardstyle
sounds_like: Euphoric hardstyle/trance lead, kicks at ~150 BPM.
meaning: 'We're all gonna make it' aesthetic physique culture.
timing: Pose/flex changes on every 2nd kick; drop = shirt-off reveal or best-angle shot.
visual: Flash on kicks, chromatic aberration, low-angle mirror shots.
risk: Copyrighted music; respect the Zyzz legacy (avoid mocking). In-app only.

name: 'Nah, I'd win' (Gojo, JJK)
sounds_like: Calm anime voice 'Nah, I'd win.' over tense strings.
meaning: Confidence before facing something huge (a 3-plate deadlift, a boss, a 20-hour layover).
timing: Line ends 4-6 frames before the cut to the challenge; hold a stare 20 frames.
visual: Slow push-in on your face, subtitles, then smash cut to the attempt.
risk: Anime IP; in-app only. Peaked 2024; fine as ironic.

name: 'Let him cook'
sounds_like: Voice line 'let him cook' / 'let him cook, let him cook' chant; often over a beat.
meaning: Trust the process, he's onto something.
timing: Line drops when someone tries to interrupt; continue the action underneath.
visual: Chef emoji/flame overlay, slow-mo.
risk: Voice clip; in-app only. Slang aging.

name: GTA 'Wasted'
sounds_like: Slow-mo whoosh, low drone, then a sting as red 'WASTED' text appears.
meaning: Total failure / comic death.
timing: Slow down to 30-40% speed over 6 frames on the fail, desaturate to grey over 15 frames, 'WASTED' text lands at frame ~20 with the sting; hold 45 frames.
visual: Grey grade, slow-mo, red serif 'WASTED' text (use your own font, not Rockstar's pricedown asset).
risk: Rockstar-owned sound and look; in-app SFX only. Downlifter + boom from library recreates the feel legally.

name: Minecraft damage 'oof' / Roblox 'oof'
sounds_like: Short grunt 'oof' (~0.3 s).
meaning: Small damage, mild pain, 'that hurt'.
timing: On the contact frame (bump, dropped dumbbell on foot, stubbed toe).
visual: Red flash 2 frames (damage tint), 3-frame shake.
risk: Roblox replaced its 'oof' in 2022 after a licensing dispute (composer Tommy Tallarico); both are third-party IP. In-app only.

name: Mario coin
sounds_like: Two-note bright chiptune 'ba-ding' (~0.4 s).
meaning: Small win, money saved, +1.
timing: On the frame the item/price/rep counter appears; stack on each item in a list (min 6 frames apart).
visual: Item pops up 8 px with a spring; coin icon or '+1'.
risk: Nintendo IP: in-app only. Library 8-bit coin (CC0) is an original chiptune coin, not the Mario one; use it to stay safe.

name: Level-up fanfare (RPG)
sounds_like: Ascending chiptune arpeggio / FF victory fanfare (~1-2 s).
meaning: Progress, upgrade, new PR, new gear.
timing: Arpeggio's last note lands on the reveal (new PB on the bar display / new GPU in the case).
visual: 'LEVEL UP' text with glow, particle burst, stat bars filling.
risk: Final Fantasy fanfare is Square Enix IP; use the library CC0 level-up instead.

name: MLG hitmarker + airhorn
sounds_like: Sharp tick 'hitmarker' clicks + 3-burst air horn, dubstep wub.
meaning: Ironic 'pro gamer' montage (MLG 2014 parody).
timing: Hitmarker on each hit frame; airhorn bursts on the 3 beats after the play.
visual: Hitmarker cross overlays, Doritos/Mountain Dew parody props, 'wow' text, shake.
risk: Deeply retro/ironic. Air horn is generic, but the CoD hitmarker is Activision audio; use a library click for the hitmarker.

name: 'Mission failed, we'll get 'em next time'
sounds_like: Military voice line + failure sting (CoD MW2).
meaning: Failed attempt, try again tomorrow.
timing: After the fail, black overlay fades in over 10 frames, line plays, text centred.
visual: Desaturated, 'MISSION FAILED' text, slow zoom-out.
risk: Activision audio; in-app only.

name: Among Us emergency meeting / 'sus'
sounds_like: Alarm-like emergency meeting horn / 'dun-dun' imposter stinger.
meaning: Someone is acting suspicious; betrayal.
timing: Hit on the frame you catch the 'imposter' (friend skipping leg day, someone eating your fries).
visual: Red 'EMERGENCY MEETING' text, red vignette pulse.
risk: Innersloth IP; in-app only. Dated (2020) unless ironic.

name: Secret discovered / item get
sounds_like: Short ascending 'da-na-na-naaa' discovery jingle.
meaning: Found something cool: a hidden cafe, a BIOS setting, a gym hack.
timing: Jingle's final note on the reveal frame; raise item over head (literally) for 30 frames.
visual: Hold item up, light rays overlay, text 'You found: ...'.
risk: Nintendo IP; in-app only. Library chime-success is the safe swap.

name: PlayStation 1 / PS2 startup
sounds_like: Swelling synth pad + chime (PS1) / deep ambient (PS2).
meaning: Nostalgia, boot-up, 'the setup is complete'.
timing: Swell starts at frame 0, logo-like reveal of your setup at the chime.
visual: Black screen to your desk setup, lens flare.
risk: Sony-owned; in-app only. Don't show Sony logos.

name: Curb Your Enthusiasm outro ('Frolic')
sounds_like: Bouncy tuba + mandolin circus theme, starting abruptly.
meaning: Awkward self-own ending; things went wrong in a comedic way.
timing: Freeze on the most awkward frame, music starts on that exact frame, 'Directed by Robert B. Weide' credit fades up ~1 s in; total 3-5 s.
visual: Freeze + slow zoom to 110% over 3 s, black-and-white optional, credits text.
in_app: Instagram audio: 'curb your enthusiasm'; CapCut: 'curb outro'
risk: Copyrighted composition (Luciano Michelini). In-app only.

name: SpongeBob time card ('A few moments later')
sounds_like: French-accented narrator: 'A few moments later...' / 'Two thousand years later...' with a ukulele sting.
meaning: Time skip (waiting for a flight, food, a render, a rest timer).
timing: Full-screen card 45-60 frames, hard cut in and out (no transition).
visual: Bright text card in the SpongeBob style (use a similar font, not the logo).
in_app: CapCut: 'few moments later'; Instagram: 'a few moments later'
risk: Nickelodeon IP; in-app only. Very well known; best as a quick time-skip, not as the joke.

name: Taco Bell bong
sounds_like: Big resonant bell-like 'BONG' with long decay.
meaning: Dramatic emphasis on something stupid or suspicious.
timing: On the punchline frame; freeze 15-20 frames; let the tail ring.
visual: Zoom punch + freeze, no shake.
risk: Brand sound; in-app only.

name: 'Fahhh'
sounds_like: Strained, frustrated shout 'FAHHH!' (from streamer Taileons, viral on TikTok via football edits from Sept 2025).
meaning: Missed it by THAT much: a near-miss, failed rep, missed shot, missed flight.
timing: Shout starts on the miss frame (ball hits post, bar stalls); freeze or slow-mo for the shout (~25 frames).
visual: Slow-mo replay, zoom on the near-miss, 'so close' text.
risk: Creator's voice: in-app only. Peak trend late 2025: still recognisable in 2026 but fading; don't stack with other voice memes.

name: Censor beep
sounds_like: 1 kHz sine beep.
meaning: Covers a swear; also implies a swear for comedy.
timing: Beep exactly spans the word (cut in on its first frame, out on its last); mute the original under it.
visual: Black bar or pixelate over mouth for the same frames.
risk: Safe (a sine tone is not copyrightable): generate with ffmpeg: ffmpeg -f lavfi -i sine=f=1000:d=0.5 -af volume=-12dB beep.wav.

name: 'Oh no, oh no, oh no no no no no'
sounds_like: Kreepa 'Oh No' song: chanted 'oh no' over a beat.
meaning: Disaster about to happen; anticipation of a fail.
timing: Start 1-1.5 s BEFORE the fail so the 'no no no' hits on it.
visual: Slow-mo on approach, then real-speed fail.
risk: Copyrighted song; in-app only. Overused 2020-22.

name: Coffin dance (Astronomia)
sounds_like: EDM track 'Astronomia' synth lead.
meaning: Fatal fail, 'rest in peace'.
timing: Cut to the coffin-dance segment on the first synth hit after the fail.
visual: Pallbearers green-screen or just slow-mo of the fail.
risk: Copyrighted song; very dated (2020).

name: 'To Be Continued' (Roundabout)
sounds_like: Yes - 'Roundabout' guitar intro, then freeze.
meaning: Cliffhanger right before a disaster.
timing: Song intro starts ~2 s before the fail; freeze on the frame before impact; sepia + 'To Be Continued' arrow slides in from the left over 8 frames.
visual: Freeze, sepia grade, arrow graphic.
risk: Copyrighted song; in-app only. Also good as a part-1/part-2 hook.

name: Wilhelm scream
sounds_like: Classic film scream of a man falling.
meaning: Cartoonish fall / someone 'dies' (wipeout).
timing: Starts on the frame the person loses balance.
visual: Slow-mo fall.
risk: Studio-owned recording (Warner); in-app only.

name: Crickets
sounds_like: Night crickets chirping.
meaning: Awkward silence, no one laughed, empty gym/no likes.
timing: Cut all music; crickets for 45-60 frames over a static shot.
visual: Static wide shot, tumbleweed optional.
risk: Generic nature sound; CC0 cricket recordings exist on Freesound (not in this library yet).

name: Ba-dum-tss (rimshot)
sounds_like: Drum fill: snare-snare-cymbal.
meaning: Bad pun / dad joke.
timing: Cymbal hit lands 6 frames after the punchline word.
visual: Wink to camera, small zoom.
risk: Generic; easy to record yourself. Cringe if the joke is not deliberately bad.

name: Sad trombone ('wah wah wah waaah')
sounds_like: Descending 4-note muted trombone.
meaning: Failure, game-show loss.
timing: Last long note on the fail freeze, 60 frames total.
visual: Freeze, desaturate.
risk: Generic melody, but recordings are owned; in-app or record your own.

name: Air horn
sounds_like: Stadium air horn blasts.
meaning: Hype, celebration, MLG irony.
timing: Bursts on the beat right after the win, 3 x 8 frames.
visual: Shake, confetti.
risk: Ear-fatiguing; keep it 6 dB under the boom level.

name: Bonk
sounds_like: Hollow cartoon wood/plastic 'bonk'.
meaning: Smack for a bad thought ('go to horny jail', 'stop it').
timing: On contact frame; 3-frame squash on the target.
visual: Cheems/dog meme bat, squash-and-stretch.
risk: Generic sound; library hit-impact (CC0) is a usable recreation.

name: Cartoon boing / slide whistle
sounds_like: Spring 'boing' or rising/falling slide whistle.
meaning: Silly bounce, sudden jump, things falling over.
timing: Boing on the bounce apex; slide whistle spans the fall (start on loss of balance, end on landing).
visual: Squash and stretch, bounce ease.
risk: Cringe in serious content.

name: Dramatic 'dun dun DUNNN'
sounds_like: Three dramatic orchestral/organ hits.
meaning: Shocking reveal (dramatic chipmunk).
timing: Three hits on three zooms: 100->115->130->150%, 8 frames apart, ending on the reveal.
visual: Triple zoom punch on the face.
risk: Generic; library impacts can rebuild it.

name: Law & Order 'dun-dun'
sounds_like: Two heavy metallic 'DUN DUN' clanks.
meaning: Case closed / scene change with gravity.
timing: Over a black card with a location/time stamp; 2 hits 10 frames apart.
visual: White typewriter text on black: 'GYM - 06:03 AM'.
risk: NBC-owned; in-app only. Library gym clank + boom makes a legal version.

name: Jeopardy 'Think!' music / Kahoot lobby
sounds_like: 30-s game show countdown tune / Kahoot lobby loop.
meaning: Waiting, thinking, loading.
timing: Under a time-lapse of waiting (render bar, queue, rest timer). Cut on any bar line.
visual: Countdown timer overlay, fast-forward.
risk: Copyrighted; in-app only.

name: Wii Shop / Mii Channel music
sounds_like: Chill bossa-nova muzak.
meaning: Calm browsing, shopping, waiting; ironic calm in chaos.
timing: Loop under shopping/building montage, duck -20 dB under voice.
visual: Cozy shots, setup tour.
risk: Nintendo IP; in-app only.

name: 'Hello darkness, my old friend'
sounds_like: Opening line of 'The Sound of Silence'.
meaning: Sad realisation / back to the grind.
timing: Start on the realisation frame; slow zoom; fade to black.
visual: Dim lighting, slow push.
in_app: Instagram audio: 'hello darkness my old friend'
risk: Copyrighted song; dated.

name: Owen Wilson 'wow'
sounds_like: Drawn-out 'woooow'.
meaning: Unimpressed/impressed sarcasm.
timing: On the reveal; hold 20 frames.
visual: Static reaction.
risk: Film audio; in-app only.

name: Rizz sound ('boing' + eyebrow)
sounds_like: A wobbling 'bwomp/boing' with a pitch bend (the TikTok 'rizz' effect).
meaning: Smooth flirt / smooth move.
timing: On the eyebrow raise / smooth line; 1 per video.
visual: Eyebrow raise, wink, zoom to 115%.
risk: Slang aging; cringe risk high for gym/tech audiences.

name: Cat laughing / 'huh' cat
sounds_like: Looped cartoonish laugh / one confused 'huh?'.
meaning: Laughing at a fail / confusion.
timing: 'Huh' on the frame the confusing thing is shown; laugh 12 frames after a fail.
visual: Cat cut-in (green screen) or just reaction.
risk: Trending 2024-26 in TikTok soundboard lists; in-app only.

name: 'Yippee!'
sounds_like: Tiny high-pitched creature cheering 'yippee!'.
meaning: Wholesome tiny win.
timing: On the success frame (bar locks out, package arrives, flight boards).
visual: Confetti burst, tiny bounce.
risk: Popular in 2025-26 meme soundboards; in-app only.

name: 'Sheesh'
sounds_like: Drawn-out 'sheeeesh'.
meaning: Impressed (a big lift, a clean build).
timing: Start on the reveal, let it run over a slow pan (~1.5 s).
visual: Slow pan over the build/physique.
risk: Peaked 2021; record your own for authenticity.

name: 'Omae wa mou shindeiru... NANI?!'
sounds_like: Calm Japanese line followed by a shocked 'NANI?!'.
meaning: You're already finished; shocked reaction.
timing: Calm line over a stare, 'NANI' on the hard zoom punch.
visual: Zoom punch + red flash.
risk: Anime IP; dated.

name: 'Directed by Robert B. Weide'
sounds_like: Same as Curb outro.
meaning: End-credit self-own.
timing: Use with the Curb outro: credit text 1 s after the freeze.
visual: White text on black.
risk: See curb-outro.

name: Dial-up modem
sounds_like: 56k modem handshake screech (~5-20 s, use 2 s).
meaning: Slow internet, old tech, 'loading...'.
timing: Over a frozen loading bar; cut at a screech peak.
visual: Loading spinner, pixelated image loading top-down.
risk: Recordings of real modems on Wikimedia Commons are often PD/CC; check the file page.

name: Hacker 'I'm in'
sounds_like: Fast typing bed + a deadpan 'I'm in.'
meaning: Breaking into something trivial (BIOS, router settings, a jar lid).
timing: Typing for 30-60 frames, 'I'm in' on the frame the screen changes, then 1 click.
visual: Green terminal text, hoodie, dark room.
in_app: Record the line yourself; typing from library.
risk: Safe if you voice it yourself.

name: Startup chime (Mac / Windows boot)
sounds_like: Big C-major chord 'bong' (Mac) or ambient Windows startup swell.
meaning: New build boots / first power-on.
timing: Chime on the exact frame the RGB/monitor turns on.
visual: Black to lit setup, bloom.
risk: Apple/Microsoft-owned sounds; in-app only. Library chime-success is a safe substitute.

name: Fake phone notification / message ping
sounds_like: Short 'ding'/'tri-tone' message notification.
meaning: A text/DM arrives (from your gym bro, your mom, the airline).
timing: Notification banner slides down over 5 frames (ease-out) with the ding on its first frame.
visual: Custom banner (no Apple/WhatsApp branding).
risk: Avoid real iPhone tri-tone (Apple-owned). Library dings are CC0.

name: Cha-ching cash register
sounds_like: Register bell + drawer open.
meaning: Money spent/saved, deal found, 'that's expensive'.
timing: On the price-tag reveal frame.
visual: Price text pops in with spring overshoot.
risk: Library has CC0 versions; safe.

name: Heartbeat tension
sounds_like: Slow 'lub-dub' heartbeat, speeding up.
meaning: Nerves before a max attempt, landing approach, unboxing price.
timing: Beat interval shrinks toward the moment; silence on the moment itself (1 frame before the action), then hit.
visual: Vignette pulse on each beat (2-frame 103% scale).
risk: Library has CC0 heartbeat; safe.

name: Crowd cheer / sitcom applause
sounds_like: Stadium crowd roar or studio audience applause.
meaning: Celebration (ironic for small wins).
timing: Start on the success frame, fade out over 30 frames.
visual: Slow-mo, confetti.
risk: Library has CC0 crowd recordings; safe.

name: Airplane cabin chime (seatbelt 'bing-bong')
sounds_like: Two-tone cabin PA chime.
meaning: Departure/arrival, 'we are now landing', new chapter.
timing: On the cut to the window/wing shot; second tone on the title card.
visual: Plane window, location title slides in.
risk: Record it on your own flight (your recording = your copyright) or use the library ding.

name: 'Where to next?' passport stamp / suitcase zip
sounds_like: Stamp thud + zip.
meaning: Trip announcement, next destination.
timing: Stamp thud on the frame the destination text slams in.
visual: Passport stamp graphic, map zoom.
risk: Generic foley; easy to record on your own.

name: Camera shutter 'photo dump'
sounds_like: Mechanical shutter click.
meaning: Photo dump / still frame / 'snapshot'.
timing: Each still flashes white for 1 frame with the shutter on that frame; 6-10 frames per photo on the beat.
visual: White flash + still frame + polaroid border.
risk: Library has CC0 shutters; safe.

name: VHS rewind 'let's go back'
sounds_like: Tape rewind squeal / tape-stop.
meaning: Let's rewind to how this started / redo.
timing: Reverse the clip at 3-4x for 15-30 frames with the rewind sound; tape-stop on the last frame before a reset.
visual: VHS overlay, scanlines, '<< REW' text.
risk: Library has CC0; safe.

name: Glitch / data corruption
sounds_like: Digital stutter/buzz.
meaning: System malfunction, brain lag, mind blown.
timing: Glitch spans 4-8 frames at the cut point.
visual: RGB split + block displacement for 4-8 frames.
risk: Library CC0; safe.

name: 'Just a chill guy' lo-fi
sounds_like: Mellow lo-fi/jazzy piano loop (the 'my new character' chill guy trend).
meaning: Unbothered calm while chaos happens.
timing: Bed at -22 dB under VO, text 'just a chill guy' as the hook in frame 0.
visual: Calm static shots, you doing nothing during chaos.
risk: Peaked late 2024-25; character art is the artist's copyright (Phillip Banks) - don't use the drawing.
